name: @neuropause/persistence
description: NeuroPause Enterprise Persistence Platform (NCEA 12.0) — the one durable storage layer: relational (PostgreSQL), knowledge graph, append-only event store, object storage, cache, versioned/reversible migrations, backup & recovery, and multi-tenant isolation. Validated against a real embedded Postgres (PGlite); networked Postgres, Redis, and S3 are production drivers behind the same interfaces.
